phrase: "In one measured thirty-day window, one MCP server appeared in 93,983 search results and was invoked zero times." (Section 1 of entry 19)
corrected_1: 93,983 is the impression count shown by the dashboard of one MCP directory on which the operator's own server is listed, for the thirty days to 2026-08-14 (93,983 impressions, 24 clicks, 421 profile views); it is not a count of search results across search engines or AI assistants
corrected_2: zero is the number of tool calls made through that one directory listing in the same window; it is not the server's total. The server's own usage counter recorded calls in that window; it stores no IP addresses and cannot separate the operator's automated checks from outside calls, so how many calls came from outside is not known
source: the Traffic paragraph of verify-directory/index.html in github.com/ogasurfproject-jpg/horizon-shield, which states the dashboard figures with their date

not_yet_corrected: papers/nenrin-reproducibility/manuscript_v0.1.md repeats the sentence; it has two authors and is corrected only when both approve
what_stays: the argument of Section 1 (an agent choosing between servers can read only what each vendor wrote about itself) and every other section of entry 19; this record changes no hash
